description: Single free O atom, TYPE='PBE' + !NTBO HFWEIGHT=0.25 DCTYPE='SCANL' (PBE-SL0r), 12 friction-damped steps -- exercises both the DATH/ADDPOT and CHI-basis/POT_LOC reference-functional-swap fixes (the dev notes, 'Known bugs'). O's species block carries real PRB2017 LHFWEIGHT. Reference updated 2026-09-27 for the exact local-orbital projection (35017eb); the old fit gave -9.7400675814 (VESPAW_NTBO_OLDPROJ=1). Updated again 2026-09-27 for the full SCAN-L onsite potential (gradient and Laplacian terms); 12-step trajectory energy, not converged. -- re-referenced 2026-09-29 after the default relativistic treatment changed from ZORA to energy-dependent scalar-relativistic (cross-optimizer agreement and finite-difference checks unchanged) -- re-referenced 2026-10-02 for the corrected PBE reduced gradient (TFAC ported from CP-PAW 2024; also fixed in the SCAN correlation code; TYPE=-10 reproduces the old values) -- re-referenced 2026-10-03: published PBE beta, SCAN-L PC07opt deorbitalization, spin-polarized SCAN correlation, CODATA 2018 constants (output now in eV; references stay in Hartree) (the SCAN-L double counting changed with the PC07opt parameters)
